risk_type: Explicit uncapped or unlimited liability wording
question: Does the clause expressly connect liability or damages to uncapped, unlimited, or outside-the-cap wording?
pattern: \b(?:liabilit(?:y|ies)|damages?)\b.{0,100}\b(?:uncapped|unlimited|without limitation|outside (?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap|not subject to (?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap)\b|\b(?:uncapped|unlimited|without limitation|outside (?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap|not subject to (?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap)\b.{0,100}\b(?:liabilit(?:y|ies)|damages?)\b
exclude_patterns: ["\\b(?:not|never|shall not|will not|is not|are not)\\s+(?:be\\s+)?(?:uncapped|unlimited)\\b","\\bneither party\\b.{0,80}\\bunlimited liability\\b","\\bno party\\b.{0,80}\\bunlimited liability\\b"]
explanation: The clause contains express uncapped/unlimited liability language. Flag for buyer-side review of the cap, carve-outs, and monetary exposure; this is not a conclusion that the term is unlawful.

risk_type: Indemnification stated to be uncapped or outside the liability cap
question: Does the clause expressly state that indemnification is uncapped, unlimited, or outside the liability cap?
pattern: \b(?:indemnif(?:y|ication|ity|ies)|hold harmless)\b.{0,180}\b(?:uncapped|unlimited|outside (?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap|not subject to (?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap|excluded from (?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap)\b|\b(?:uncapped|unlimited|outside (?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap|not subject to (?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap|excluded from (?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap)\b.{0,180}\b(?:indemnif(?:y|ication|ity|ies)|hold harmless)\b
exclude_patterns: ["\\b(?:not|never|shall not|will not|is not|are not)\\s+(?:be\\s+)?(?:uncapped|unlimited)\\b","\\bnot\\s+excluded from\\b","\\bnot\\s+outside (?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap\\b","\\b(?:all|the indemnification obligation)\\b.{0,70}\\bsubject to (?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap\\b"]
explanation: The clause expressly links an indemnity obligation with uncapped or outside-the-cap language. Review the indemnity scope and its coordination with the liability cap.

risk_type: Liquidated damages stated to be outside the liability cap
question: Does the clause expressly put liquidated damages outside or exclude them from the liability cap?
pattern: \bliquidated damages?\b.{0,180}\b(?:outside|excluded from|not subject to|not governed by)\b.{0,60}\b(?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap\b|\b(?:outside|excluded from|not subject to|not governed by)\b.{0,60}\b(?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap\b.{0,180}\bliquidated damages?\b
exclude_patterns: ["\\b(?:not|never|shall not|will not|is not|are not)\\s+(?:be\\s+)?(?:outside|excluded from|unlimited)\\b","\\bnot\\s+excluded from\\b","\\bnot\\s+outside (?:the )?(?:aggregate )?(?:liability )?cap\\b"]
explanation: The wording expressly separates liquidated damages from a liability cap. Review the cap interaction, calculation method, and potential cumulative exposure.

question: Does the clause expressly permit termination immediately or without prior notice?
exclude_patterns: ["\\b(?:may not|shall not|must not|cannot|can not)\\b.{0,60}\\bterminat(?:e|es|ed|ion|ing)\\b.{0,80}\\b(?:immediately|without (?:prior )?notice|with immediate effect)\\b","\\bterminat(?:e|es|ed|ion|ing)\\b.{0,100}\\bonly after\\b.{0,80}\\b(?:notice|cure period|opportunity to cure)\\b"]
explanation: An immediate/no-notice termination right is explicitly present. Check who holds the right, the triggering event, cure protections, and transition consequences.

risk_type: Perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, or sublicensable IP license wording
question: Does the clause pair a license with perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, or sublicensing language?
exclude_patterns: ["\\bnon[- ]sublicensable\\b","\\bno\\s+(?:perpetual|irrevocable|worldwide)\\s+licen[cs]e\\b","\\b(?:perpetual|irrevocable|worldwide)\\s+licen[cs]e\\b.{0,60}\\b(?:not granted|not provided|shall not be granted|will not be granted)\\b"]
explanation: The clause pairs license rights with one or more broad-scope terms. Review purpose, territory, duration, transfer/sublicense rights, ownership, and post-termination effects.

risk_type: Full remaining-term fees or minimum commitment after early exit
question: Does the clause connect early/convenience termination with payment of the full remaining term or minimum commitment?
pattern: \bterminat(?:e|es|ed|ion|ing)\b.{0,180}\b(?:for convenience|early|without cause)\b.{0,240}\b(?:full remaining term|remaining term|minimum commitment|remaining fees|all fees for the remainder)\b|\b(?:full remaining term|remaining term|minimum commitment|remaining fees|all fees for the remainder)\b.{0,240}\bterminat(?:e|es|ed|ion|ing)\b.{0,180}\b(?:for convenience|early|without cause)\b
exclude_patterns: ["\\b(?:not|shall not|will not|does not)\\s+(?:be\\s+)?(?:liable for|pay|owe|charge)\\b.{0,100}\\b(?:remaining term|minimum commitment|remaining fees)\\b","\\b(?:waived|forgiven|credited|pro[- ]rated)\\b.{0,80}\\b(?:remaining term|minimum commitment|remaining fees)\\b"]
explanation: The clause links early termination to payment for the remaining term or the full minimum commitment. Review pro-rating, mitigation, credits, and exit exceptions.

question: Does the clause expressly prohibit assignment under any circumstances or without exception?
pattern: \b(?:absolute(?:ly)?\s+prohibit(?:ed|s)?|may not|shall not|must not)\s+assign\b.{0,140}\b(?:under any circumstances|in any circumstances|without exception)\b|\b(?:under any circumstances|in any circumstances)\b.{0,140}\b(?:may not|shall not|must not)\s+assign\b
explanation: The text contains an express absolute assignment prohibition. Review affiliate, internal restructuring, financing, and change-of-control exceptions.
